answer: Proof of Burn serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to irreversibly destroy native tokens to gain consensus weight. By transforming capital into a relic of lost utility, the protocol imposes a direct financial cost on sybils, as the expense of spawning identities scales linearly. While a simple sonnet of code might trigger a gale of malicious requests, an agent lacking sufficient burnt equity cannot influence state transitions, effectively pricing out large-scale identity flooding.
